item.title: T. Wangyal, "The Tibetan Yogas of Dream and Sleep" (3.5/5)
item.description: A good overview of Tibetan Buddhist thinking. In relation to sleep, it claimed to be a requirement to know Dzogchen practices or thought; I did not struggle to understand. Book can be somewhat underwhelming if you've read enough on dreams/sleep, trance, or meditation.
